decision.reason: [ev-1b184dd5af6a] is a single highlight line that names the feature and the Kustomization kind. It does not say which spec field or kustomization.yaml key enables optional components, what "optional" means in practice (for example, skipping missing component paths), or whether existing behaviour changes. The rest of the section is made up of unrelated one-line highlights, and no upgrade-guide section about this subject is shown, so nothing else describes the feature. The validator refuted treating the whole Kustomization GVK as added because kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 Kustomization already exists in the earlier release [ev-782bc47d120d][ev-c2c6c790d6b2]. That means the subject must be a field-level addition that the evidence never identifies, and we would need the API docs or changelog entry that names that field.
